title: Mimas modifier
description: A flat damage modifier (modifiers/*.json). Who owns it is the attachment (unit, terrain, map hex, rules.globalModifiers), never this file.

description.description: What it does. Do not describe the reveal rule here; 'visibility' carries that and the HUD writes its own copy.

trigger.description: dealDamage: consulted on the attacker's side. takeDamage: the target's side.

visibility.description: hidden: unknown to the opponent until it first changes a result. Tile and global modifiers should stay public.

damageTypes.description: The attack's lane is one of these.

tags.description: The attack carries any of these tags.

elements.description: The attack carries any of these elements (design: #elements). Update this enum when rules.elements changes.

itemKinds.description: The ability was granted by an item of any of these kinds (bow, gun, ...). An innate ability never matches.

heightAdvantage.description: The attacker's tile is higher than the target's.

effect.description: Exactly one of damage (a flat amount) or nullify (immunity: the total becomes 0 after everything else).

damage.description: Flat amount added to the damage. Must not be 0.

nullify.description: Immunity (design: #damage rule 3). Mutually exclusive with damage.
